review_kind: Assistant-supported bounded release-support engineering screen; not a new owner or independent scientific judgment.

reviewed_risks.risk: Missing or coherently rewritten component, version, prerequisite or payload inventory
reviewed_risks.fresh_gate: Anchored #56 matrix/policy/overlay, complete 687 selected payload hashes and required support closure; damaged-package regressions.

reviewed_risks.risk: Lifecycle schema8 or endpoint/version/as-of history diverges from the bounded contract
reviewed_risks.fresh_gate: Current lifecycle/inventory replay plus original migration/source bindings and full software checks before freeze.

reviewed_risks.risk: Frozen snapshot generation silently rebound to current documentation/consistency
reviewed_risks.fresh_gate: Separate historical-generation rows/edges, all 380 old selected bindings and 237 frozen source files must remain exact.

reviewed_risks.risk: Downloaded source needs hidden Git history/network or accepts omitted tooling
reviewed_risks.fresh_gate: Actual temporary source archive, no .git, Git or network; exact complete-manifest comparison and recomputed-omission negative controls.

reviewed_risks.risk: Prospective support inadvertently enables or mutates publication intent
reviewed_risks.fresh_gate: Code-owned hashes preserve old registries/requests/tools/workflows; v0.3.5 remains unregistered with no request.

reviewed_risks.risk: Old successful deployment receipts mistaken for fresh final-source readback
reviewed_risks.fresh_gate: Future actual final-source native Wiki and every served Pages body, root manifest, timestamps and source checks; preserve four frozen snapshots.

reviewed_risks.risk: Engineering passes inflate scientific outcomes, manuscript claims or independent acceptance
reviewed_risks.fresh_gate: Preserved accepted source/model/paper scope, all 306 IDs/236 deferred, historical engine populations, zero new ratings and 11 WITHHELD admissions.

reviewed_risks.risk: Self-recomputed manifest drops, duplicates, adds or traverses source paths
reviewed_risks.fresh_gate: Require exact unique safe full filesystem inventory, sizes/hashes, regular files and additional anchored required closure; externally trusted final digest remains separate.

reviewed_risks.risk: Dirty/changed source or skipped/failed checks accepted as final release evidence
reviewed_risks.fresh_gate: Future clean exact HEAD plus actual final candidate checks and six staged assets; support validation performs no freeze.

reviewed_risks.risk: New release overwrites existing tag/assets or reports the wrong Latest
reviewed_risks.fresh_gate: Future only-new tag/release and independent six-asset public downloads/Latest with all eleven prior release inventories unchanged.

future_freeze_gates: Clean exact source HEAD and complete affected source/full software checks.
Fresh actual documentation 0.4.0 Wiki (23 files) and Pages (311 served files plus root manifest) readback at the final source; preserve four frozen snapshots.
Dry freeze and independent validation of all six staged release assets.
Explicit publication activation only after successful reviewed freeze.
Independent actual public downloads, tag/Latest and all eleven prior release/asset inventories.
limits: The current screen covers release-support preparation; final clean-source/channel/freeze/publication gates remain unexecuted.
No known unresolved critical support finding is not a universal zero-defect guarantee.
Offline integrity is not publisher authentication; independent source/digest/readback verification remains mandatory.
All broad scientific/application/deployment and conference requirements retain their separate criteria.
